# Admin login, roles and audit logs

Description

Add admin authentication and role management (admin/staff) plus audit logging of operator actions.

Acceptance criteria

- Login and role assignment implemented.
- Role-based access control enforced on admin endpoints.
- Audit trail for critical actions (imports, price approvals, manual edits).
